title: Oscar and the Echo
author: Mirabel Dunmore
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
